_strategy_options: bid_ask | spot | hybrid  # hybrid = ONE single-sided SOL position holding a Bid-Ask layer + a Spot layer
_hybridBidAskPct_note: only used when strategy is hybrid: Bid-Ask share 1-100 (default 60). The Spot share is DERIVED (100 - this) and cannot be set separately.
_bidAskFlip_mode_options: off | shadow | live  # shadow = plan + simulate + log, never signs (recommended first); live = sign and send
